contracts: (An unchanged tracked-membership control passes and isolated add/delete/rename mutations each fail the snapshot comparison; frozen project history remains untouched.) AND (Unchanged membership passes; add/delete/rename fails.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
selector_intents: Exercise current_git_fingerprint and git_snapshots_match in an isolated Git fixture with unchanged, added, deleted and renamed tracked members; a changed membership must invalidate the preservation check.
Run the real snapshot comparator with unchanged, added, deleted, and renamed tracked paths; require only the unchanged control to pass.
